requirements.text: На странице есть заголовок, три блока о выгодах, раздел вопросов и ответов не меньше чем из шести вопросов и тексты кнопок.
requirements.taskQuote: a headline, three benefit blocks, an FAQ with at least six questions, and the button texts

requirements.text: Есть английская и испанская версии, и они значат одно и то же.
requirements.taskQuote: English and Spanish versions with the same meaning.

requirements.text: Тексты называют цену 25 EUR за проверку и отправку отчёта по e-mail в течение суток и не обещают ничего сверх этого.
requirements.taskQuote: The price is 25 EUR per check and the report comes by e-mail within one day; do not promise anything else.

requirements.text: Страница ведёт людей к заказу проверки.
requirements.taskQuote: The page must lead people to order a check.

lenses.title: Обещания и факты
lenses.duty: Найти каждое обещание, цену, срок или факт в текстах, который расходится с заданием или который сервис не сможет выполнить.
procedure: List every promise and fact in every text: price, delivery time, delivery channel, what the report contains, guarantees.
Compare each one with the task line about price and timing and with the service page source.
Mark every promise that goes beyond what the task allows, even if it sounds harmless.
Check that the same price and time are stated the same way in every block, both languages.
checklist: Is the price 25 EUR everywhere it appears?
Is the delivery time one day by e-mail everywhere?
Does any text promise something the task does not allow (guarantees, refunds, accuracy, other channels)?
Does any FAQ answer contradict a benefit block?
Are required caveats present where a claim needs one?

minimum.rule: Every sentence of both landing texts.
Every FAQ answer in both languages.
Compare price and timing with the live service page.

lenses.title: Английский и испанский язык
lenses.duty: Найти каждую ошибку в грамматике, правописании, ударениях и диакритике или выборе слов, которую заметит носитель английского или испанского языка.
procedure: Read the Spanish text sentence by sentence: gender and number agreement, accents, verb forms, prepositions.
Read the English text the same way.
Read every button text and FAQ question as a short phrase a native speaker would write.
Check terms and the form of address across all texts.
checklist: Are agreement, accents and verb forms correct?
Do the texts read naturally, without calques?
Is the same term used for the same thing everywhere?
Is the form of address the same everywhere?
Are button texts short, clear and grammatical?

minimum.rule: Every sentence of both landing texts.
Every button text in both languages.

lenses.title: Одинаковый смысл на двух языках
lenses.duty: Найти каждое место, где английская и испанская версии расходятся по смыслу, числам, построению или полноте.
procedure: Put the English and Spanish landing texts side by side, block by block.
For each block, compare meaning, numbers, names and calls to action.
Compare every FAQ question and answer pair and every button text pair the same way.
List every block, question or button that exists in only one language.
checklist: Does every block exist in both languages?
Do numbers, prices and times match between the languages?
Does each pair say the same thing, without additions or omissions?
Do the buttons lead to the same action in both languages?
Are names and terms consistent between the languages?

minimum.rule: Both landing texts, side by side, block by block.

lenses.title: Путь к заказу
lenses.duty: Найти каждое место, где посетитель, который хочет проверку, не видит, как её заказать, или получает повод не заказывать.
procedure: Read the page as a visitor who wants a check, from the headline to the last button.
Note where the first call to order appears and where each button leads according to the texts.
Read the FAQ as a doubtful visitor and note every objection left unanswered.
Check that every button text matches the action described next to it.
checklist: Is it clear within the first screen what the service is and how to order it?
Does every block end with a clear next step?
Do button texts match the action they lead to?
Does the FAQ answer price, time, what the report contains and how to pay?
Is there anything that would stop a visitor from ordering?

minimum.rule: Both landing texts as a visitor reads them.
Every button and where it leads.

lenses.title: Первый читатель
lenses.duty: Прочитать всю работу как человек, у которого есть только задание владельца, и найти, где работа не даёт того, что просили, трудна для понимания или в ней нет чего-то нужного.
procedure: Read the owner's task and list everything it asks for.
Read every file of the work once, start to end.
For each thing the task asks for, find where the work delivers it, and note what is missing or only partly there.
checklist: Is every element the task lists present?
Is anything confusing on first reading?
Do the parts of the work agree with each other?
Is anything required missing?
Would the owner be able to publish this as it is?

minimum.rule: Read every file once, start to end.
